captions.detailed: A compact, palm-sized camcorder designed with a main rectangular body that features rounded edges. On the front, there is a short, cylindrical lens barrel. Attached to the left side of the body is a flat, rounded-edge flip-out monitor panel that sits flush against the main housing. The entire assembly is presented in a uniform matte light gray material.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact handheld camcorder. The design should feature a main rectangular body with rounded vertical corners, a short cylindrical lens barrel extending from the front, and a flat side-mounted flip-out screen panel attached to the left side.
captions.factory: The camcorder is constructed as an assembly of three main parts. First, the main body is created using a Box primitive with filleted vertical edges. Second, the lens assembly is modeled as a Cylinder representing the barrel, positioned on the front face of the body. Third, the flip-out screen is formed from a thin Box with rounded edges, offset and positioned adjacent to the main body's side panel.
